name: "Shrimp Scampi" Pasta with Swiss Chard, Lemon & Parmesan Bread Crumbs

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, then stir for a few seconds. Cook until pasta is desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ¼-cup cooking water before draining and set aside.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
5 oz spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in a small bowl and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and toast, stirring frequently, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Add to the bowl with the Parmesan, along with spices, and stir to combine; set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp butter, unsalted
¼ cup panko bread crumbs
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp crushed red pepper
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry chard; fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves and stems into bite-sized pieces, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a medium bowl (reserving stems for later use).

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chard stems, shrimp, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until shrimp are just opaque, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add cooked pasta and reserved pasta water to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until water has evaporated, 1-2 minutes.
Add chard leaves to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chard is tender, about 1 minute.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the skillet. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with cheesy bread crumbs. Enjoy!
